notes: IB Tracker now makes a sound when something goes right — a short chime as you tick off a task, a warmer one when you finish a study session, and a little fanfare when you level up.
Study streaks are celebrated too: reach 3, 7, 14, 30 days and up, and you'll hear about it.
If a timer or a pomodoro break ends while you're working in another app, you now get a desktop notification, so you can look away from the tracker without missing the end of a block.
All of it can be switched off in Settings → Sound & notifications.
